notes: Idea: cyclehound (import-graph/circular-import checker in Rust; CLI + wasm page). Measured madge 8.0.0 14.1-17.8 s/327-363 MB and dependency-cruiser 16.10.4 51.8 s/2,272 MB on ventures/ (11,422 .mjs files); cyclehound 0.19-0.26 s/17-20 MB. Graph identical to madge with --no-require (11,422 nodes, 9,417 edges); vs depcruise with --no-type every edge shared, depcruise extra = 11 CSS imports. Repo has 31 files in 9 load-time cycle components; all 22 .mjs ones load cleanly from any entry (latent, not bugs). No separate docs/reports agent doc: README Limits + opinion piece carry the next steps (tsconfig paths, CI gate). Local checks: cargo test 13 pass, clippy/fmt clean, node tests 15 pass, Playwright page check clean. CI round 1 failed on new-venture gates (see errors), all fixed in the same PR.
